name: activity-tree-intent-geometry
description: A 200-character intent cannot starve a short delegate name or hide its own Open control. Real phone Sheet insets, 360/390/430px viewports, and nested activity rows through four groups exercise the shipped denseMeta cap and ellipsis without product CSS overrides.

mutation.note: Chrome exited 1: all nine names fell below 16px (6.84-9.61px) and every meta exceeded 60% of row content width. The 430px root also lost its full name. Stylesheet restored byte-for-byte before the passing runs.
